Build me a personal portfolio website with:

- An about section describing my background

  media icons

Now running Phase 1 in parallel — fonts, colors, and about image:Phase 1 done. Now Phase 2 — building Header and Footer in parallel:Now building Header and Footer simultaneously:Now building the homepage — Phase 3:Now update RootLayout with the correct site-wide meta:Your portfolio homepage is live in the preview. Here's what was built:

- **Hero** — Monumental oversized name in Cormorant Garamond with a staggered word-by-word entrance animation, terracotta accent eyebrow, and a subtle scroll indicator
- **About** — Asymmetric two-column layout with a portrait photo (offset accent border detail), bold statement headline, and bio text with an animated "Get in touch" arrow link
- **Contact** — Large email link with a hover underline-draw effect, plus GitHub, LinkedIn, and Twitter icons with scale + color hover states
- **Header** — Transparent over the hero, goes solid on scroll with elegant underline-draw nav hover effects
- **Footer** — Single-line minimal with a smooth back-to-top link

Looks great! Let's add my real name and info. I'm Alex Rivera, a freelance UX designer. Tagline should be "Designing experiences that feel effortless." For the about section: I've been doing UX and product design for 8 years, worked with startups and Fortune 500 companies, specialize in mobile apps and design systems. Email is alex@alexrivera.design, LinkedIn is linkedin.com/in/alexrivera, and Dribbble instead of Twitter for the social icons.

Lucide doesn't have a Dribbble icon, so I'll use a custom SVG for that. Now making all the updates in one pass:Now update the header wordmark and footer copyright:Also update the RootLayout meta:Everything's updated with your real info. Here's what changed across the site:

- **Name** updated to Alex Rivera everywhere (hero, header wordmark "AR", footer, alt text, meta tags)
- **Tagline** is now "Designing experiences that feel effortless."
- **About bio** reflects your 8 years of UX experience, startup + Fortune 500 background, and mobile/design systems specialization
- **Email** updated to `alex@alexrivera.design`
- **Socials** now show LinkedIn (linked to `linkedin.com/in/alexrivera`) and Dribbble with a custom SVG icon — GitHub and Twitter removed

This looks fantastic! Really happy with how it turned out. The design is clean and professional — exactly what I was going for.

DONE

Really glad it hit the mark! Your portfolio is looking sharp — the editorial typography, warm terracotta accents, and clean layout make for a strong first impression. Whenever you're ready to take the next step, some natural additions would be a projects/work section to showcase your UX case studies, or publishing the site so it's live with a custom domain.
